entities.summary: Nikolay Aleksandrovich Pankov is a former Russian military officer who was the State Secretary and Deputy Minister of Defense of the Russian Federation between 13 September 2005 and 17 June 2024. He is the General of the Reserve Army. He is a 1st class Active State Councillor of the Russian Federation, promoted in 2011. He is a PhD in law, associate professor.
